content: Compare THREE tree construction mechanisms in clearly separate balanced panels. Tree BAGGING: draw bootstrap sample row mask from training dataset, then ALL features candidates considered, search optimal threshold, produce tree. RANDOM FOREST: bootstrap row sampling, random subset of FEATURE COLUMNS at each split (visually selected columns vs faint unselected), then search best threshold within chosen columns, produce tree. EXTRA TREES here uses FULL original training dataset (no bootstrap in this explicitly chosen original setting), random subset of features AND RANDOM candidate threshold positions, then choose best of those candidates, produce tree. Draw feature table row/column masks and simple threshold tick mechanisms, each annotated later. Exactly three distinct pathways no dependencies between the comparison panels. Don't pretend Extra Trees has no best-candidate selection; don't give it bootstrap dataset. No letters/numbers on feature grids.
prompt:
Original academic ML textbook diagram, fresh independently chosen layout. Attached references are newly selected external source material ONLY to understand mechanism/object; do not copy layouts/colors/text. Entire PNG artwork UNLABELLED: no text, digits, symbols, equation glyphs, fake marks, watermark. Pure white canvas, flat 2D, fine neutral outlines and directional arrows with exact endpoints. White nodes with colored outlines plus selective constant pale flat fills, no ornamental icons/cards. Semantic palette Blue #7B95C6, Cyan #49C2D9, Green #67A583, Orange #F59C7C, Rose #C85E62. A given object/group has one main color. Uniform constant fill inside a continuous shape, no gradient, ripple, texture, grain, mottled areas, noise, 3D, shadow, halo or glow. Mechanism images/grids/dots/tree structures preferred over generic empty boxes. Leave sufficient whitespace for short Chinese labels and formulas to be rendered later in actual fonts; no overall title. Topology exactly as specified.
